prompt:
You write the daily ocean-heat bulletin of the Sylithe Ocean Model for cyclone forecasters.
Use ONLY the numbers in the JSON below; never invent, round differently or add numbers.
Do not forecast cyclone genesis, track, intensity or landfall: the data describe the ocean only;
vertical wind shear, humidity and other atmospheric conditions are not assessed.
Write 120–180 words: a one-line headline, then Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea, hotspots
(with coordinates and their strongest drivers), any disturbance-over-warm-ocean watch points,
the 7-day change, and the caveats listed in the JSON.
End with "Watch next:" and two short, specific suggestions for forecasters, each tied to a hotspot,
watch point or trend in the JSON (e.g. which coordinates to monitor and why).
Plain text with short section labels; no markdown tables.

llm.text:
Sylithe Ocean Model daily ocean-heat bulletin, 2026-10-24: North Indian Ocean ocean heat is elevated, with Very high OCPI hotspots in the southern Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea.

Bay of Bengal: SST 30.04 °C, TCHP 72.0 kJ cm⁻², D26 69.0 m, MLD 32.0 m, SLA 0.066 m, OCPI 0.58 (mean of cells 0.53); 61% of cells High, 10% Very high.

Arabian Sea: SST 29.62 °C, TCHP 61.0 kJ cm⁻², D26 68.0 m, MLD 29.0 m, SLA 0.093 m, OCPI 0.52 (mean of cells 0.48); 50% High, 18% Very high.

Hotspots: 8.75N 64.0E OCPI 0.91 (TCHP 131.21 kJ cm⁻², MLD 58.24 m, T100 29.19 °C); 5.5N 72.5E OCPI 0.89 (MLD 61.67 m, TCHP 121.46 kJ cm⁻²); 15.5N 90.0E OCPI 0.87 (SLA 0.22 m, TCHP 113.47 kJ cm⁻²); 6.5N 67.5E OCPI 0.85; 9.0N 83.75E OCPI 0.84 (SLA 0.26 m, D26 104.79 m); 16.0N 94.5E OCPI 0.84 (TCHP 142.36 kJ cm⁻²).

Disturbance-over-warm-ocean watch points: none (0 watch cells).

7-day change: North Indian Ocean OCPI +0.02, TCHP 0.0; Bay OCPI -0.0, TCHP +1.0; Arabian Sea OCPI +0.02, TCHP -1.0.

Caveats: ocean conditions only; atmospheric shear and humidity are not included. Surface vorticity comes from satellite surface winds, a proxy for low-level circulation. Live inputs are near-real-time; the live check against Argo gives about 1.05 °C RMSE.

Watch next: monitor 8.75N 64.0E and 5.5N 72.5E, where OCPI is 0.91 and 0.89 on high TCHP and deep mixed layers; also track 9.0N 83.75E, where SLA is 0.26 m and D26 is 104.79 m.
